title: Cloud Tenant Provisioning
scenario: NewVue Health has completed the initial provisioning of a Microsoft 365 tenant to support its transition toward hybrid cloud services. The tenant uses Microsoft 365 Business Premium and the initial cloud domain newvuehealth.onmicrosoft.com. The global administrator account has already been created and can access the Microsoft 365 administration environment. Before the organization proceeds to cloud identity, hybrid identity, and device management tasks, the system administrator must confirm administrative access, identify the correct portals, review the tenant environment, configure company branding, and validate that the new sign-in experience is visible to users.

activities.title: Tenant Access Confirmation
activities.prompt: You want to confirm that the newly provisioned tenant is accessible and ready for administrative review. Move the required actions into the Answer Area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: Sign in using the administrator account
Confirm that the tenant dashboard loads successfully
answer: Sign in using the administrator account
Confirm that the tenant dashboard loads successfully
activities.explanation: The administrator must first sign in, confirm that the tenant environment is available, and then verify that the subscription is active.

activities.title: Portal Roles
activities.prompt: You want to continue administration of the new tenant. Match each administrative portal to the type of management it primarily provides.
activities.explanation: Each portal has a distinct administrative scope in the Microsoft cloud environment.

activities.title: Accessing Intune
activities.prompt: You want to access the Intune admin center from the Microsoft 365 admin center. Select the action that best supports that objective.
options: Open Admin centers and select Endpoint Manager / Intune
Open Billing and select Your products
Open Users and select Active users
activities.answer: Open Admin centers and select Endpoint Manager / Intune
activities.explanation: The Intune administrative interface is accessed from the Admin centers area of the Microsoft 365 admin center.

activities.title: Subscription Review
activities.prompt: You want to verify that the tenant is licensed correctly before moving forward with additional cloud configuration. Select the administrative area where this check is performed.
activities.explanation: Subscription and licensing status is reviewed under Billing in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

activities.title: Initial Cloud Domain
activities.prompt: You want to confirm the initial domain assigned during tenant creation. Select the value that represents the default cloud domain in this case study.
activities.explanation: The default Microsoft 365 tenant domain uses the onmicrosoft.com naming format.

activities.title: Branding Configuration Workflow
activities.prompt: You want to configure the organization’s sign-in experience. Move the branding stages into the Answer Area and arrange them in the correct order.
activities.explanation: The branding wizard follows a staged sequence from basic settings to final review.

activities.title: Branding Validation
activities.prompt: You want to verify that the new sign-in branding is visible to users after the configuration is saved. Select the best validation method.
options: Open a private browser window and test the sign-in page
Create a new Azure virtual machine
activities.answer: Open a private browser window and test the sign-in page
activities.explanation: A private browser session reduces cached sign-in artifacts and gives a cleaner validation of the updated branding experience.
